gist.summary: Added Fable Finder to the writing app catalog. Enter a lesson you keep forgetting, and it generates a four-line fable with a picture on the spot.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art reading nook, Polli wears a tiny storyteller's hat and sits beside an open book showing a four-line fable and its little picture, with flowers growing around the shelves. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene, strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a prominent soft lime green (#ecf874) glow and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
